newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin up five cents to 14.27 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin up five cents to 14.27 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price rose five cents to 14.27 ringgit ($5.74) a kg despite an overnight fall on the London Metal Exchange (LME), traders said.
"There was some good covering demand, so the price went up a little instead of following the LME," said a trader.
There were bids for 134 tonnes, against bids of 83. Final turnover was 71 tonnes against 100 on Tuesday. Buyers were Japanese and Malaysians.
The local price was at a premium of $65 against London, from $30 on Tuesday.
